dev.state: future signed round, no DEV seed or panel materialized in r0
dev.target_rule: Independent custodian admits the FIRST complete signed dual-policy/implementation lock exactly once. Let T be floor(UTC Unix seconds of its independently time-stamped and append-only receipt). Freeze r = 1 + ceil((T + 120 - genesis_unix_utc_s)/3). Publish receipt, both child hashes, lock-file SHA-256 and r before genesis+3*(r-1); no clock or round chosen by either improver and no second lock. Archive receipt and proof of publication time.
dev.verification: After the lock, the scorer obtains the specified quicknet round from any relay or an offline copy, verifies the BLS signature for that round and pinned chain key/scheme using the official verification routine, then takes SHA256(raw signature) as the 32-byte beacon randomness. Archive the signed response and verifier version. A late or unverifiable lock is retained as unscored; a temporarily unavailable response can only be fetched for the same r.
dev.derivation: SHA256(UTF8("AegisDC/T8/r0/DEV/v1") || one 0x00 byte || raw public root || raw 32-byte SHA-256 of the immutable dual-lock artifact || verified 32-byte beacon randomness). Use its unsigned big-endian integer. Only the scorer constructs DEV after both locks. No round data was fetched at r0.
